description.zh: 一块能平移缩放的图面：矩形、圆、菱形、文本和曲线箭头，拖框线跟着走
description.en: A pannable, zoomable canvas: boxes, circles, diamonds, text and curved arrows that follow the shapes

help.zh: 拖动和缩放时对齐到 8px 的格子。关掉之后可以摆到任意像素，但两个框很难对齐。
help.en: Aligns dragging and resizing to an 8px grid. Turn it off to place things at any pixel, at the cost of lining boxes up by hand.

tools.name: draw
tools.description: Replace the diagram. One line per node or edge, e.g. 'Api -> Db' or 'Cache:circle'.

tools.name: add
tools.description: Append to the diagram, same line format as draw: 'A -> B', 'Name:box|circle|diamond'.

tools.name: read
tools.description: List the node labels and the connections of the current diagram.

items.zh: 双击空白处加一个矩形，底栏最左边那颗也能加。加完直接打字，回车存下。
items.en: Double-click empty space to add a rectangle, or use the leftmost button in the bottom bar. Type straight away; Enter keeps it.

items.zh: 底栏四个按钮依次是矩形、菱形、圆、文本——菱形留给判断，文本只有字没有框。
items.en: The four buttons on the left are rectangle, diamond, circle and text — diamond is for decisions, text is words with no frame.

items.zh: 选中一个框，四个角上有把手，拖它们改大小。按 Delete 删掉，挂在它身上的线一起删。
items.en: Select a box to get handles on its corners; drag them to resize. Delete removes it and any line attached to it.

items.zh: 点底栏的箭头按钮，然后依次点两个框，就有一条带箭头的曲线。方向是第一个指向第二个。
items.en: Click the arrow button in the bottom bar, then click two boxes; you get a curved arrow from the first to the second.

items.zh: 线的两端挂在框上，不是画在坐标上的——拖框、改大小，线自己跟着走，永远接在边上。
items.en: Both ends hang off the boxes rather than fixed coordinates — move or resize a box and the line follows, always touching an edge.

items.zh: 点线本身可以选中它，再按 Delete 删掉。删框的时候不用管线，它会被一起带走。
items.en: Click a line to select it, then Delete to remove it. Removing a box takes its lines with it, so you never orphan one.

items.zh: 空白处按住拖动是平移，滚轮也是平移；Ctrl 加滚轮（或触控板双指捏）是缩放。
items.en: Drag empty space to pan, or use the wheel; Ctrl with the wheel (or a trackpad pinch) zooms.

items.zh: 底栏最右边那颗「适应窗口」把整张图装进卡片。放大到 250% 就到顶了，再大没有意义。
items.en: The last button, Fit to window, puts the whole diagram back in the card. Zoom stops at 250%.

items.zh: 图比卡片大是正常的——平移着看，不要为了看全把卡片拉到半个屏幕。
items.en: A diagram bigger than the card is normal — pan around instead of stretching the card across half the screen.

items.zh: 选中框后点那个半圆按钮换色调：中性、强调、警示三档，颜色跟着平台主题走。
items.en: With a box selected, the half-circle button cycles three tones: neutral, accent and warning. The colours follow the platform theme.

items.zh: 撤销 50 步，Ctrl+Z 退回。一次拖动算一步，不是每帧一步。
items.en: Fifty steps of undo on Ctrl+Z. One drag counts as one step, not one per frame.

items.zh: 关掉卡片再打开，图还在。同一个组件摆两份是两张不同的图。
items.en: Close the card and open it again and the diagram is still there. Two copies are two different diagrams.

items.zh: 给它一句「把这三个服务画成一条链」，它会用同样的框和曲线画出来，位置自己排。
items.en: Ask it to draw three services as a chain and it lays out the same boxes and curves itself.

items.zh: 它一次画一整张（替换）或者往后加；不管哪种，Ctrl+Z 一步就能整体退回。
items.en: It either draws a whole new diagram or appends to the current one; either way a single Ctrl+Z takes it back.

items.zh: 这条能力要单独授权（属性面板里那行 Agent tool calls）。不给它，它就画不进来。
items.en: This needs its own permission — the Agent tool calls row in the inspector. Without it, nothing can be drawn in.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：矩形、圆、菱形、文本四种图形，曲线连线两端挂在框上，拖框线跟着走。
changes.en: First release: rectangles, circles, diamonds and text, with curved connectors anchored to the shapes so lines follow them.

changes.zh: 平移、缩放、8px 吸附、50 步撤销；关掉卡片再打开图还在。
changes.en: Pan, zoom, 8px snapping and fifty steps of undo; the diagram survives closing the card.

changes.zh: assistant 能直接画：说一句「三个服务连成一条链」，它排版、画线，一次调用算一步撤销。
changes.en: The assistant can draw: describe a chain of three services and it lays out and connects them, one undo step per call.
